   201	/-! ### The structure sheaf satisfies the packaging
   202	
   203	`Scheme.moduleKSheaf k` carries the tautological action `qsmul h r s = X.resHom h r * s`

   212	/-- Reinterpret a section of `X.moduleKSheaf k` over `W` as a scheme section in

   215	private def moduleKSheafToΓ {W : X.Opens} (s : (X.moduleKSheaf k).obj.obj (op W)) :
   216	    Γ(X, W) := s
   217	
   218	/-- The structure sheaf as a sheaf of `k`-modules is quasi-coherently packaged on every
   219	open `U`: ambient sections act by restriction-then-multiplication, and the localization
   220	axioms are `IsAffineOpen.exists_res_eq_pow_mul` and
   221	`IsAffineOpen.exists_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_res_eq_zero`. -/
   222	noncomputable instance Scheme.moduleKSheaf.instQcohOn (U : X.Opens) :
   223	    Scheme.QcohOn (X.moduleKSheaf k) U where
   224	  qsmul {W} hWU r s := X.resHom hWU r * moduleKSheafToΓ s
   225	  one_qsmul {W} hWU m := by
   226	    change X.resHom hWU 1 * moduleKSheafToΓ m = moduleKSheafToΓ m
   227	    rw [map_one, one_mul]
   228	  mul_qsmul {W} hWU r s m := by
   229	    change X.resHom hWU (r * s) * moduleKSheafToΓ m =
   230	      X.resHom hWU r * (X.resHom hWU s * moduleKSheafToΓ m)
   231	    rw [map_mul, mul_assoc]
   232	  add_qsmul {W} hWU r s m := by
   233	    change X.resHom hWU (r + s) * moduleKSheafToΓ m =
   234	      X.resHom hWU r * moduleKSheafToΓ m + X.resHom hWU s * moduleKSheafToΓ m
   235	    rw [map_add, add_mul]
   236	  qsmul_add {W} hWU r m n :=
   237	    mul_add (X.resHom hWU r) (moduleKSheafToΓ m) (moduleKSheafToΓ n)
   238	  secRes_qsmul {V W} hVW hWU r m := by
   239	    change X.resHom hVW (X.resHom hWU r * moduleKSheafToΓ m) =
   240	      X.resHom (hVW.trans hWU) r * X.resHom hVW (moduleKSheafToΓ m)
   241	    rw [map_mul, Scheme.resHom_resHom]

   243	    obtain ⟨N, e, he⟩ := hV.exists_res_eq_pow_mul hVU g (moduleKSheafToΓ c)
   244	    refine ⟨N, e, ?_⟩
   245	    change X.resHom inf_le_left e =
   246	      X.resHom (inf_le_left.trans hVU) (g ^ N) * moduleKSheafToΓ c
   247	    rw [map_pow]
   248	    exact he

   250	    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hV.exists_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_res_eq_zero hVU g
   251	      (moduleKSheafToΓ t) ht
   252	    refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
   253	    change X.resHom hVU (g ^ M) * moduleKSheafToΓ t = 0
   254	    rw [map_pow]
   255	    exact hM

Address or explicitly acknowledge unread conversations before ordinary advisory inbox material.  # Task Task: MT.CH01 Title: Morgan-Tian Ch1: re-verify 15 demoted nodes, close the 3 ready Project(s) — work across all of them: - MorganTian at formalized-sources/MorganTian  Morgan-Tian CHAPTER 1 ONLY (Preliminaries from Riemannian geometry). You are one of three MorganTian lanes launched together; MT.CH02 holds chapter 2 and MT.CH03 holds chapter 3. Stay inside your chapter's write set.  YOUR WRITE SET: MorganTianLib/Ch01/**, blueprint/src/chapters/Ch01_Preliminaries.tex, hgraph/nodes/**. Do NOT write MorganTianLib/Ch02/**, MorganTianLib/Ch03/**, or the other chapters' .tex — those belong to the sibling lanes and the scheduler's advisory lock will not save you from a lost edit.  WHERE CHAPTER 1 STANDS. 123 tex nodes: 85 closed, 3 ready, 20 blocked, 15 formalized-but-open, 23 informal. 164 Lean files under MorganTianLib/Ch01, zero sorries. So this chapter is not greenfield — it is mature, and its remaining value is concentrated in two places.  (1) THE 15 DEMOTED NODES, which are the higher-value half of your work. These are in state `formalized_open`: the Lean exists and compiles and is anchored, but the blueprint no longer asserts that the anchored type states the full TeX claim. They lost their \leanok when distilled prose was imported and the wording changed. They are:    prop:minimal-geodesic-no-conjugate, thm:bishop-gromov, lem:exponential-riemannian-jacobian,   lem:local-diffeomorphism-bounded-curvature, lem:cut-locus-properties, lem:local-isometry-exponential,   cor:exponential-local-diffeomorphism, lem:cut-time-star-shaped, lem:local-isometry-rigidity,   thm:hopf-rinow, lem:local-isometry-covering, thm:sectional-curvature-comparison,   prop:exponential-diffeomorphism-cut-locus, lem:exp-pullback-volume-comparison,   thm:ricci-curvature-comparison  For each: read the anchored Lean type and the current TeX statement side by side, then either restore \leanok (only if the type states the FULL claim — every hypothesis, every quantifier, the same generality) or leave it demoted and record on the hgraph node exactly what the gap is (`graph -p MorganTian add comment <node> --body ...`). A precise gap note is a real deliverable; a restored \leanok that is not earned is worse than the demotion. Note that some of these are heavyweight named theorems (Hopf-Rinow, Bishop-Gromov, the two comparison theorems) whose Lean may legitimately be narrower than the book statement — if so, say so and leave it off.  READ INBOX I-0396 FIRST. It is the human's account of why these marks are untrustworthy: the mechanical detector that was supposed to find them scored 0.26 precision, both model passes disagree on 29 of 165 nodes always in the same direction (the cheap pass over-clears), and hand-adjudication went against the cheap pass. Treat "this one looks equivalent" with suspicion — that is the exact failure mode that produced this mess.  (2) THE 3 READY NODES: prop:cone-curvature (Curvature operator of cone, 61 downstream unlocks), lem:geodesic-polar-form (Radial geometry in geodesic polar coordinates, 122 unlocks and 15 uses — the single highest-impact ready node in the chapter), claim:second-variation-minimal-geodesic (Second variation is zero iff Jacobi field, 102 unlocks). lem:geodesic-polar-form is where a session buys the most downstream. The last MT session was mid-flight building toward cone/warped-product curvature via product-field brackets and the four Levi-Civita formulas, and had concluded there is no upstream warped-product or cone-curvature theorem in the dependency closure — read run 0752's last sessions before re-deriving that.  BUILD. MorganTian requires DoCarmoLib, so `lake build` here also trace-checks DoCarmo/.lake/build. DoCarmoLib is green (272 oleans) and you must NOT edit DoCarmo/** — several other lanes trace-check it and dirtying it forces a rebuild underneath them mid-flight (the olean race in inbox I-0109). LeeRiemannian requires MorganTianLib, so check `horizon ps` before a full build. Prefer the lean-lsp MCP and `lake env lean <file>` over `lake build`; cap with LAKE_NUM_THREADS=4 when you must build.  SEARCH BEFORE PROVING. `"$HORIZON_BIN" search "<words>" --json` spans every project AND mathlib. DoCarmoLib holds the shared Riemannian infrastructure (Levi-Civita, geodesics, exponential map, curvature) and is sorry-free; read it freely.  BLUEPRINT IS FROZEN except for genuine corrections — protection I-0395, enforced by .githooks/pre-commit. Add/remove \lean{} and \leanok as formalization state changes; never add prose, formalization notes, or Lean commentary to the .tex. Those go on the hgraph node. Pic representability itself is not yet closed. The remaining honest substrate is a quotient-sheaf comparison identifying `coker(O(aTheta-d) → O(aTheta))` locally with the new quotients and globally with `IntrinsicThetaGlued`.

Unconditional evaluation surjectivity is false at low twist; the proof must use the existing high-window inputs without adding hypotheses.

The completed unit reaches the next real geometric boundary. Claiming representability now would conceal the missing quotient-sheaf range and naturality proofs.

Construct `thetaIdealToTheta`, prove its local ranges equal `thetaPieceVanishing` and `thetaOverlapVanishing`, establish restriction naturality, then glue the affine cokernels to `IntrinsicThetaGlued` and apply the existing high-window surjectivity inputs.
